seed: A cross dissolve plays in the editor the way the export draws it, at Next defaults. Every picture the canvas is handed while a dissolve runs is held up against the export's picture of the same moment, and against the frames that moment shows: first a dissolve on a jump cut inside one full-screen Retina recording (key frames two seconds apart, as a Mac screen recording has), then one where that recording meets a second clip. Each is played from half a second before, from its very first frame, at half speed and at double. The user saw a dissolve flicker on and off in the editor on 2026-11-20 while the exported file was clean.

steps.note: A full-screen Retina recording cut at a quarter and at the middle, the middle thrown away, and a cross dissolve on the jump cut: both sides of the dissolve come from one recording
A second recording let go on V1 over the end of the first, and a cross dissolve where the two clips meet: the full-screen recording carries on past its cut under the one coming in
